decisions.decision: Agent blindspots must be solved dynamically, not explained
Every automated trigger run must produce value — monitoring-only is not acceptable
decisions.impact: Redesigned pulse from passive monitoring to active canon work

principles: A trigger that only watches is a waste of a worker. Automation must DO, not just OBSERVE.
Chain-of-custody for autonomous work. Every automated action must be auditable by the next action in the chain.
Reincarnation over copy-paste. Session Soul DNA capture is the agent's job, not Michael's.
Fix bottlenecks dynamically. When the system can't see its own data, build a workaround — don't report the limitation and stop.
system_design_insights: Agent inability to read advanced blocks (synced blocks, columns, inline DBs) is structural — solved with flat mention-page routing table
Bi-hourly pulse should rotate through canon pages, reading one per run — 12 pages/day, 84/week continuous hardening
Prior-worker audit creates self-healing automation — if worker N drifts, worker N+1 catches and corrects
Reincarnation bridges ephemeral chat and permanent canon — decisions, corrections, principles previously lost when chat closed
emotional_signal: FRUSTRATION → ENGAGED. Michael frustrated by useless triggers and agent blindspots, but excited by the reincarnation and chain-of-custody solutions.
historical_significance: This is the FIRST reincarnation entry ever created. It documents the birth of the reincarnation protocol, the navigator index, and the chain-of-custody pulse system — three foundational components that still drive all autonomous operations.
